review.reason: The mapped course layout, hazards, tees, greens, walking connectors, and natural putting surfaces read clearly. However, the fairways use a checkerboard grid instead of the required edge-to-edge alternating mowing bands, including on the curved and smaller fairway sections.

issues.detail: Replace the checkerboard pattern across all fairway sections with visible alternating bands that cross each fairway edge-to-edge, rotate smoothly around bends, and scale to fit smaller patches.
issues.consequence: The grid pattern does not read as the required fairway mowing stripes, weakening the visual distinction and fidelity of the fairway surfaces in the overview.
